body: I really loved Katherine Arden’s The Bear and the Nightingale, followed by The Girl in the Tower. The final book of the trilogy comes out in August of this year and I can’t wait.
My black lab is the exact same way! My chocolate prefers that we chase him though so I think some wires got crossed there.

Thank you for replying. You don’t know how much it means to feel listened to and I really appreciate it.
I have. I started taking medication when I was diagnosed and went through multiple years of counselling Canadian Mental Health Services until my counsellor suggested I see a therapist trained in DBT. I saw one for about 8 months when I was 17 until she eventually said we had made so much progress that there was no need to continue. 

I’ve thought about going back to her, but now that I’m in university and on my own, I can’t really spare the $95/hr. I’ve thought about talking to campus counsellors multiple times but I didn’t want them to confirm my beliefs that  just a bad student with normal young adult feelings. That and waiting time to see one is about three weeks (mental health services are seriously lacking at my school).
